scope: Local iRatePilot.com source checkout; booking-request and Stripe checkout JSON parsing only.
changes: Added streaming 16 KiB JSON body bounds with a declared-length early reject to reservation-request and Stripe test-checkout endpoints.
Malformed JSON, invalid UTF-8 and unsupported content types now return controlled 400/415 responses instead of uncaught parse errors.
Oversized booking and checkout payloads receive 413 before schema validation or downstream booking/payment operations.
limits: This only bounds request bodies on the two named endpoints; it does not implement a shared distributed API rate limiter.
This local validation does not prove public booking, payment, PMS delivery, or OTA-provider acceptance in hosted environments.
